verdict.rationale: Remote sign-in is a fair question for a government services portal with online accounts, so the axis applies. The only account-related item lists "Accounts (GCKey, ...)" as a navigation link and does not describe the sign-in method, MFA factors, or whether an authorized human can complete it remotely without biometrics, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN. Its mention of "biometrics" is an unrelated navigation entry and does not describe the sign-in path. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.
